name: fcpa-compliance-policy
description: Drafts and reviews anti-corruption compliance policies and programs under the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) anti-bribery provisions (15 U.S.C. 78dd-1, 78dd-2, 78dd-3) and accounting provisions (78m(b)(2)(A)-(B), books and records and internal controls), the Foreign Extortion Prevention Act (18 U.S.C. 1352) and the UK Bribery Act 2010 sections 6 and 7. Maps issuer, domestic concern and UK scope; sets the facilitation payment election; classifies state-owned enterprise staff as foreign officials; writes gifts, travel and hospitality rules with a business-purpose test; tiers third-party intermediary due diligence; builds internal controls, M&A successor liability steps, training and hotline; and dates the 2025 enforcement pause, DOJ FCPA guidelines, Corporate Enforcement Policy and ECCP. Use for an FCPA, anti-bribery or ABAC policy, gift and hospitality policy, third-party due diligence procedure, or adequate procedures review. Declines paper-program policies built to look compliant but enable bribes.
